messages:
Dana (Finance): CostBot flagged ~ $6,450 of untagged GPU spend in us-east4 early this morning. Can platform triage?
CostBot: ALERT: 2026-06-02 03:18 UTC - UNTAGGED_GPU - $6,450 - 9 GPUs - projects: 4 - /billing/alerts/20260602-09
Ishaan (Platform): On it. Quick hypothesis: cross-region autoscale fallback launched instances in us-east4 when us-west quotas hit burst limit. Those fallback instances didn't pick up team labels. Running quick query.
Ishaan (Platform): Query:
```
SELECT project_id, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM billing.gpu_usage
WHERE date='2026-06-02' AND region='us-east4' AND label_team IS NULL
GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY cost DESC;
```
Ishaan (Platform): Top three projects: experiments-intl ($3,900), partner-zenith-poc ($1,700), infra-housekeeping ($600).
Marta (ML Eng): experiments-intl was my team's cross-validated transfer learning sweep. I remember enabling cross-region fallback to speed up the run. We thought cost labels would carry over.
Leo (SRE): We shipped fallback routing change yesterday to avoid throttles. It looks like metadata propagation fails on cross-region fallback. I'll add a validation in the routing layer.
Dana (Finance): partner-zenith-poc could be billable. Grace, can we provisionally credit until attribution confirmed?
Grace (Head of Finance): Approve provisional credit up to $1,700 for partner projects pending confirmation. Internal $4,750 can be allocated to team experiment budgets and infra buffer. Please log in FIN-1450.
Ishaan (Platform): Kicked off tag backfill against those project ids. ETA 25m. Backfill command: /ops/cost backfill --date 2026-06-02 --region us-east4 --set-label label_team
Marta (ML Eng): I'll paste the job ids and confirm which runs were partner-facing in FIN-1450.
Leo (SRE): Action: add a check to cross-region routing that copies labels and fail fast if missing. Also schedule a nightly orphan sweep for the next 7 days.
CostBot: Created ticket FIN-1450 and attached initial alert export /billing/exports/20260602-untagged.csv
Ishaan (Platform): Backfill completed. Diff: $1,650 -> partner-zenith-poc, $3,800 -> experiments-intl, $600 -> infra-housekeeping. Pushed CSV to FIN-1450.
Dana (Finance): I'll draft the partner note and possible credit memo. Grace approved provisional credit. Recap actions: Ishaan backfill done, Leo fixes routing and schedules sweep, Marta confirms job ids, Dana opens FIN-1450 with credit draft. Thanks :thumbsup:
